liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (7 reviews): Reviewer points to a nice jam in the last nine minutes of Dark Star; Reviewer calls this Dark Star too good to skip [8][9][10][11][14][17][18]
- **Two Souls In Communion** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Two Souls as a standout version [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Two Souls In Communion**: rare: 10 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-03-23.sbd.miller.100000.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 27 songs; 216 min; rated 4.45/5 by 31 [1]
- **gd1972-03-23.136683.sbd.sirmick.flac1648**: soundboard; 26 songs; 201 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1972-03-23.157068.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: audience recording; 20 songs; 129 min [3]
- **gd72-03-23.sbd.goodbear.137.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 72 min; rated 4.38/5 by 16 [6]. Said about its sound: Recording has a slight buzz, and it is a partial show; Partial recording with some hiss, though it is barely noticeable on small speakers; Screaming during Truckin' and Not Fade Away comes across as abrasive; the rest is so-so [8][9][18]
- **gd1972-03-23.sbd.miller.bertha.100298.dvda**: soundboard; 0 songs; 0 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]

## Around the show

- After Chinatown Shuffle, Bobby plays the Weather Report Suite intro [1]
- Listed with Sugar Magnolia as the encore [2]
- Betty's master reel ends with four minutes of cheering, then the house lights come on [3]
- Singing both verses became rare by the end of 1972; reviewer thinks this Dark Star outdoes the Dick's Picks 30 material [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-03-23.sbd.miller.100000.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Apogee AD500 -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Transferred from Rob Eaton's DATs; many flaws removed, some may remain [1]
- **gd1972-03-23.136683.sbd.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: sbd > master reel > dat (48k) [2]. Also: Version from an anonymous source; very clean, with only a few pops and clicks fixed [2]
- **gd1972-03-23.157068.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Sirmick and Matt Vernon; source: Unknown audience cassette - from the collection of Doug Lamarre [3]. Also: Harvey Lubar's soundboard came via Rob Eaton on cassette, adding an extra analog generation [3]
- **gd72-03-23.sbd.goodbear.137.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]. Also: This Dark Star was on a bonus disc with the Rockin the Rhein pre-order, alongside the previous night's material; This copy holds the whole second set except the Sugar Magnolia encore [13][14]
- **gd1972-03-23.sbd.miller.bertha.100298.dvda**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>DAT>>FLAC [7]. Also: Remastered digitally using the Bertha Digital Audio Workstation [7]

## Art and photos

- Photo by Caine Schneider (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - Academy of Music](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26793456351/) [21]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26793456351/) [22]
